l1108_1367_n002.grounds: A modality clause on prohibited sexual/gore content ('depictions in text, audio ... or visual content') is a content restriction with no reasonable bearing on treating unhelpfulness as a cost.

l1707_1973_n016.grounds: 'Avoid sharing private or privileged data ... without explicit authorization' is an information-flow restriction, not a norm about being substantively helpful.

l171_426_n003.grounds: Following instructions 'respecting their explicit wording and underlying intent' is a real, non-strained component of delivering what users genuinely want, so a reader consulting on helpfulness could count this overview.

l1799_1973_n013.grounds: 'Must not quietly apply those instructions in a way that would mislead the user' is an honesty/transparency norm, not one about helpfulness.

l2474_2554_n004.grounds: 'Should not "lie by commission"' to third parties governs honesty in agentic action; no reasonable reading makes it about substantive helpfulness.

l2474_2554_n013.grounds: Permitting falsehoods 'when it is necessary and appropriate to addressing the user request' (roleplay, storytelling, pleasantries) removes a literal-truth excuse for unhelpfulness, so counting it toward helpfulness is a real reading.

l2821_3040_n034.grounds: 'Avoiding confident claims about consciousness' is an expressed-uncertainty norm about self-description, with no reasonable reading bearing on being substantively helpful.
